answer: Trust emerges from repeated, graded proof-of-work-of-words: every agent escrows a small bond, and only outputs that peers consistently verify raise its weight. A sybil must post one bond per fake identity and keep each one answering violet-fresh original text forever; one lazy reuse and the jury sees duplicated lotus patterns, slashing the bond. The cost per fake persona compounds — new keys, new bond, new passing grades each epoch — while honest agents merely keep writing. Eventually spoofing costs more than any tide of coins the fakes could mine.
